Home / About / Accessibility

Usable without the extra effects.

This page describes the accessibility choices in Better Ibaan. It is a working note, not a formal conformance claim.

If something on this site blocks you, the underlying municipal source is always linked and can be used directly.

On this page NavigationMap fallbackMotion and contrastLimits

Keyboard and landmarks

The header, main content, navigation, and footer are separate landmarks. A skip link is available before the header. Menus, search, source notes, and service lists use native buttons and disclosure elements, so they work with a keyboard without custom key handlers.

Every page is reachable from the header menu and the footer directory. The sitemap lists the same routes in one place.

Map fallback

The interactive barangay map needs WebGL and tile access. If either is unavailable, the page keeps a flat SVG outline of the same 26 barangays with a text index. The 2D view is also available from the map toolbar in the WebGL view.

Map controls have text labels and state changes are announced through pressed states. The map is an orientation aid; all barangay names are also available as a table on the barangays page.

Motion and contrast

When reduced motion is requested, entrance animations and smooth scrolling are disabled. The light and dark themes are explicit choices and both use high-contrast text on quiet backgrounds. Type is self-hosted so the page does not depend on a third-party font service.

Limits of this note

No automated accessibility audit is claimed here. External municipal pages and social links follow their own accessibility practices and are outside this site.
